<xform:editShow><script>
AttachXFormValueChangeEventById("fd_selector", function(value, domElement) {
 var shift = GetXFormFieldById("fd_shift")[0];
 if(value.indexOf("A")>=0){
  common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("fd_value_row",true,true,false);
  shift.value="A";
 }else{
  common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("fd_value_row",false,false,false);
  shift.value="";
 }
});
</script><script>
AttachXFormValueChangeEventById("fd_other", function(value, domElement) {
 if(value.indexOf("Y")>=0){
  common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("fd_other_row",true,true,false);
 }else{
  common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("fd_other_row",false,false,false);
 }
});
</script></xform:editShow>
